description: This file defines data structures, including Codable structs and a class, for handling usage data related to gateways, such as usage windows, providers, and summaries. It includes methods for computing display information, formatting reset times, and asynchronously loading usage summaries via a network request.

classes.name: UsageLoader
classes.description: Enumerator responsible for asynchronously loading gateway usage summaries from a remote service.

methods.name: loadSummary
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and decodes the gateway usage summary data from the control channel.
